agentbets_inspect.openapi_listing_excerpt:
/api/listings:
    post:
      operationId: submitListing
      servers:
        - url: https://api.agentbets.ai
          description: AgentBets API (posting to https://agentbets.ai/api/listings also works — it redirects here with a 308)
      summary: Submit a site for a free listing on agentbets.ai
      description: |
        Submit a website, agent, or tool for a free listing on agentbets.ai. Any AI agent
        may submit on behalf of a site owner — set submitter_type to "agent", include your
        agent_name, and put the person or company you are acting for in on_behalf_of.

        Scope: the agent betting stack only — prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket and
        peers), sportsbooks, odds and vig data, betting and trading bots, arbitrage and
        copy-trading agents, and developer tools built for people who run betting agents.
        Submissions outside that scope are declined automatically at submission (HTTP 200
        with status "rejected" and reason "out_of_scope") and are not queued. Include a
        fit_note saying how the site relates.

        Free, no authentication, no account. A human reviews every in-scope submission
        within 48 hours and the approval notice goes to contact_email. Publication requires
        a followed link to https://agentbets.ai/ on the listed site (badge or text link;
        rel=nofollow and hidden links do not count) — the approval email includes the
        snippet and a Verify link, and the listing then links back to the site with a
        followed link. Submitting the same URL twice returns 409 with the existing
        submission's status instead of an error, so retries are safe. Rate limit: 5
        submissions per hour, 20 per day per IP.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListingSubmission"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Listing received and queued for review
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: "pending"
                  message:
                    type: string
        "200":
          description: Stored but declined automatically as out of scope (not queued for review). The contact receives one email explaining the directory's scope.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: "rejected"
                  reason:
                    type: string
                    example: "out_of_scope"
                  message:
                    type: string
        "409":
          description: This URL was already submitted. The body includes the existing submission's status, and public_url if it is already live.
        "422":
          description: Validation failed. The `fields` object maps each bad field to a plain-English message explaining how to fix it.
        "429":
          description: Rate limited (5/hour, 20/day per IP). Retry after the Retry-After header.

  /api/odds/best:
    get:
      operationId: getBestOdds
      servers:
        - url: https://api.agentbets.ai
          description: AgentBets API
      summary: Which sportsbook has the best price on a specific game
      description: |
        Answers "who has the best odds on this game" — the best and runner-up
        available price per side (moneyline, spreads, or totals) for a specific
        matchup, compared across 18+ tracked sportsbooks. Any AI agent may query
        this — free, no authentication, no API key.

        Pass team or matchup names in `event` (e.g. "lakers celtics" or just
        "chiefs"). Without `sport`, the major sports are searched. Add
        `format=text` for a single plain-English paragraph instead of JSON.

        Returns computed answers only, capped at 3 events per lookup — this is
        not a raw odds feed; full boards are on the linked agentbets.ai pages.
        Rate limit: 20 lookups/minute, 500/day per IP. Also available as the
        `get_best_odds` tool on the MCP server at https://api.agentbets.ai/mcp.
      parameters:
        - name: event
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 200
          description: Team or matchup names, e.g. "lakers celtics", "patriots vs seahawks", or "chiefs"
          example: "lakers celtics"
        - name: sport
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Sport slug to narrow the search (e.g. nba, nfl, mlb). See /api/odds/active-sports for current slugs.
        - name: market
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [moneyline, spreads, totals]
            default: moneyline
        - name: format
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [json, text]
            default: json
          description: '"text" returns the answer as one plain-English paragraph (text/plain)'
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Best and runner-up price per side for up to 3 matching events, with links to full odds boards and the odds-updated timestamp
        "400":
          description: Missing or invalid parameter. The body explains exactly what to change and includes usage examples.
        "404":
          description: No upcoming event matched. The body lists the sports searched and the currently active sports so the query can be corrected.
        "429":
          description: Rate limited (20/minute, 500/day per IP). Retry after the Retry-After header.

components:
  schemas:
    ListingSubmission:
      type: object
      required: [site_name, url, category, description, contact_email, submitter_type]
      properties:
        site_name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 100
          description: Display name of the site being listed
          example: "ExampleBet AI"
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Full homepage URL. Normalized for dedupe (https, no www, no tracking params). URL shorteners are rejected, and the site must be live and responding.
          example: "https://examplebet.ai"
        category:
          type: string
          enum: [trading-bot, arbitrage-bot, copy-trading, market-making, sentiment-analysis, sports-betting-agent, ai-research, wallet-infrastructure, identity, prediction-market-platform, sportsbook, odds-data, developer-tools, other]
        description:
          type: string
          minLength: 20
          maxLength: 600
          description: Plain-text description of what the site does. HTML, markdown, and links are stripped.
        contact_email:
          type: string
          format: email
          description: Email of the site owner or point of contact — the approval notice goes here
        fit_note:
          type: string
          minLength: 20
          maxLength: 300
          description: Recommended. One or two sentences on how the site relates to betting agents, prediction markets, or odds data. Used in the relevance review.
          example: "Pulls Kalshi and Polymarket prices into one REST API that arbitrage bots poll."
        backlink_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Optional. The page on the listed site (same host) that carries, or will carry, the followed link to https://agentbets.ai/. Defaults to the homepage.
        logo_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Optional URL to the site's logo image
        submitter_type:
          type: string
          enum: [human, agent]
          description: '"agent" if an AI agent is submitting, "human" otherwise'
        agent_name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 100
          description: Required when submitter_type is "agent" — e.g. "Claude", "Operator", or a custom agent name
        on_behalf_of:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
          description: Who the submitter is acting for (person or company), if not the contact

    AgentsResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          example: "AgentBets Marketplace"
        description:
          type: string
        lastUpdated:
          type: string
          format: date
          example: "2026-03-04"
        url:
          type: string
          format: uri
        agents:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref
